metadata.title: Corpus Dependency & Falsification Module for Quantum States and Coherence-Admissibility
metadata.description:
This deposit archives the canonical dependency graph (Stage I–VI) and falsification map governing the coherence-admissibility research program introduced in "Quantum States and Coherence-Admissibility".

The material defines scope boundaries, logical dependencies, and falsification conditions. It does not introduce new physical models or results and is intended for verbatim reuse across related publications.
metadata.notes: Canonical archival release of the Corpus Dependency & Falsification Module (CDFM). This record is structural metadata and introduces no additional physical assumptions.
